text: I've been playing this game for approx 6yrs. Few months ago the Homescapes team decided to remove the ability of us team leaders to remove players who hadn't played for ages, this in my opinion ruined the "teams". This morning when I logged into the game a message appeared that on the UK version we are no longer able to have team chats!!!!!!! This was one of the enjoyable parts of the game. I quite appreciate that a few people may have used this in a bad way, but now no one can use this ! WRONG.

Beware...this is not the Homescapes we loved. They recently rolled out updates that make many levels almost impossible without buying powerups or lives. Sometimes you apparently join 'opponents' on challenges and they complete levels in impossible times making you last place in minutes of starting. The whole experience feels rigged now and the sole purpose is to get in game purchases. Such a shame as this was a fun way to chill and pass time. Now its no fun and I'm looking for alternatives.

It is good having goals to work to, ad free which is always good, the only downside is having to waste stars on feeding the cat or answering the door when all you want to do is get on renovating the house. A year on from the first part I have now uninstalled the game, so many mini games, seasons, treasure hunts and merge games, if I want any of those I'll download those types of games. I enjoyed this for the achievement of renovating the house and that is what I wanted to carry on doing,

This is totally mis-advertised! The adverts suggest that there will be lots of fun puzzles different from the usual generic 'match three' games. In reality it's the usual 'match three' game with an occasional fun, interesting puzzle. What an utter disappointment! I'm uninstalling this as if I want to play 'match three' games there are infinitely better ones out there.

Used to really like the game but after having to try and re try levels at least 20 times before you can pass it just became boring! At one point I was stuck on the same level for around 2 weeks just to get stars to make a phonecall! The developers want you to spend real money to progress or risk boring yourself to death going over and over and over the same levels. Finally had enough and deleted the game as there are far better very similar games out there like lost island

The first 500 levels are pretty easy, occasionally challenging, but fun. Then the stupid levels kick in. About every 3-5 levels there's a near impossible level which can only be won with particular luck of power ups, which might take 100+ replays of a level until the game lets you win. YouTube 'help' videos confirm this. It gets very tedious after a while and spoils what could be a really good game. I struggled through to 3500 to get rewards for a different game, and that's it, I've stopped.

Not as advertised. But I still played it. The game is all about renovation. And the conversation between characters is really nicely done👍. The similar colours matching game which I dint mind in the beginning but after few levels it got so hard that I was stuck on same stage for days and won't pay actual money for the energies , which can be annoying so I had to uninstall it. 3 stars for all of the hard work you guys have put in to the game.

The game itself is great. But since the Halloween event ended I cannot see avatars of who sent me lives. And I do not receive requests for lives either. I logged off from Facebook in the app settings and logged back on thinking that would sort the problem but now all the lives that I had in the inbox are gone. The customer service is useless, the only thing they told me is to restart my phone and to check if my internet connection is running...they pretty much ignore the problem.

The advert for this game is very misleading. The ad suggests that you have a list of options to fix a room in a house & you have to guess which option is best, in a fast-paced environment. In reality, you have to play a game similar to Bejewlled every time you want to complete a task. You earn 1 star with every game, then you can complete 1 task. This happens over & over. There's also a lot of mindless chat during the game that the ad didn't show. The game is also incredibly slow to load.

I've uninstalled the game as it has now got VERY greedy. I used to enjoy this game. But now your nor given enough moves to complete a level. On a hard or very hard level the only way to complete it is to spend money on it. I've spent loads of money on it and still not passes hard levels. Disgrace. I want my money back. Anybody else please avoid this game before you get trapped into spending your hard earned cash on it like many others including myself .

Don't get me wrong I do like the game but some of the levels are pretty impossible and I would say I'm quite a seasoned player at these type of games. some levels are that hard you cannot possibly pass them without loads of bombs or without purchasing extra moves. I'm still stuck on a level that I have been attempting for over a week now, just about ready to uninstall.

I like this game, but...how come you have no consistency? Some general levels are harder to win, can be impossible without boosters, than your so-called hard and extra-hard levels. This is annoying. I love the graphics, I love the game play. Sorylines are sugary, but they're safe for kids. I can't help but feel you're out to make us pay for progression though. Ok, the game is free, you have to get your money somehow, and you don't rely on ads, but it would help if our money went a bit further?

Really disappointed that the minimum reward for passing a basic level has been eliminated. Used to get 50 coins for passing a basic level, plus a bonus for unused bombs etc. Now is just the bonus, meaning sometimes you pass a level and only get 10 or so coins. Saving up my coins to 900 to get extra moves at the end of a hard level was my go to strategy on this game. Now it takes so long to get to 900 coins. Has made getting stuck even more frustrating. Have been playing for about 3 or so years.

Fun and interesting, until you get past a certain level. Heading up to level 3000 and for a while now, it's easy to get stuck on levels for days without in app purchases. Despite playing often, I've never been able to finish the side events or other activities, to achieve the rewards. It's a decent game with a lot going on but there's only so long I'm prepared to spend on the same level before I look for a new game.

would be a good game but every time you solve a puzzle it only gives you 1 star - that's not enough!! sometimes it take at least 20 attempts to solve the puzzle! the game just wants you to buy coins etc. the daily tasks are sometimes really stupid - like 'feed the cat'. the game itself isn't that bad. but the fact that it makes you buy stuff for real money is rubbish. you can be spending loads of money and going nowhere, because the puzzles are sometimes impossible to solve.

I enjoy the idea of the game and the easy levels. I don't enjoy the hard and super hard levels much. They can be very frustrating. Some of the levels are very difficult, even with lots of boosters. I try not to spend much; so I make slower progress as the game is designed to encourage you to spend money. The number of moves get reduced with regular updates for different events and when you move into another area. I had to uninstall the game at level 2073. The game didn't work after the update.

The game itself is really great, but the big rewards are all "free play for x minutes" and seem to come at random - this always seems to be at the worst possible moment, e.g. free play for 3 hours reward will pop up just as I was having a quick play before bed. If these were fewer or shorter but could be saved for when I really needed them, like the weekend, game would be 5 star for sure. As it is I deliberately play less than I want to just to avoid frustration in mornings or late at night.

Love this game I'm always playing it, as I've become addicted. Love the story and scenarios as well as the aspect of using your earnt stars (gained through wins) to design your own home, Plus there are no adds which I hate on most mobile apps! Only a few things I'd mention.... First is that the swipe is really sensitive sometimes costing you the game. Second, even though it is possible to play the game without spending money, it becomes a little tedious as lives run out quickly in the later levels and then you might have to wait an hour before you can play again. This is only annoying because sometimes the game can make you use your earned stars on trivial and silly things which hinders your game progression.

As many others have said, this is designed solely for Pay 2 Win. Looking at older reviews and feedback, it seems originally it was not so bad. If you are a new player, you will be fine until level 24 where if you look at all the tutorials online, they have 22 moves and it is a challenge. They have since reduced the moves to 10 and it is now unbeatable without spending money. I have deleted and will invest my time in another game from another developer.

DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS GAME It starts fun and interesting and gets you hooked but quickly the levels get so hard you can't progress without paying real money. The game is good otherwise, it has good graphics, and interesting storyline, I like the mix of a match three game with a home decoration game. But the game is pay to play. I've already played early levels twice after losing my progress and I've been stuck for days on one level and used all my boosters and coins. It's just not fun anymore.

The game is not as advertised hence the low score. It gave the impression of a brain teaser type game, using various items in an order to clean up or repair a house. I'm actual fact, it's a poor man's candy crush where you unlock items for your guitar after each level. the game itself may be decent if that's what you're looking for, but I do not enjoy this type of game. 1*

I enjoy this game quite alot, i like match 3 games and choosing how the rooms look. BUT the difficulty. Im on level 650ish and its getting soooo hard. Some levels i do first time, others take days or weeks. And the price of 5 more moves after you fail is extortionate. It really is a cash grab. It is possible to play without buying coins, but prepare for a long, hard challenge. The amount of coins you get awarded is a joke considering how much stuff costs. Good luck!

This game is quite good for boredom and I've had it for a while, but it has some problems (in my opinion). Here are my good and bad opinions on the game- 1: I got this app because of the ads I've seen on it, and the minigames looked fun. But i only get them once in a blue moon 2: I personally like decorating the house, but some colour choices and designs honestly look really weird and I would like more colours 3: like I said, it's good at wasting time. You could spend hours on 1 level.

Not a bad game; however I think it's rubbish that I spend hours playing to fill up the safe with gold coins; then have to spend my own £5.99 to retrieve them. What a joke!!!! Plus my friend paid for a starter pack only to be charged twice for it. Sort yourselves out!!!! 😡😡😡😡 Plus the adverts don't represent actual game play... Big con..... Funny how you never get feedback, publishers and developers know the customer is correct.

Once again, an update means I can't play this on my Amazon Fire (installed with extra memory) So that's another month I can't play it on there. Too many competitions that stall the gameplay that you can't avoid, too many hard levels, too few moves and all demand money to win. I just want to build the house, that's it, but it stalls endlessly to get money. Now it demands I update to play but when I click on download there's no update to be downloaded. Can't update, can't play. Gee, thanks!

used to love this game, but the makers have changed all the rules on the players. You are encouraged to join a group and also make friends on fb with other players enabling you to exchange lives. Since being able to do so it now takes longer to get through a level and you appear to be limited to only receiving a max of 15 lives from friends a day. I have way more than 15 friends and we all send daily. They have also reduced the bonus level to something ridiculous like once every six weeks. Don't!

This isn't the game I played in the ads at all! In the ads you help the character get out of dangerous scenarios there is absolute nothing of that sort in the actual game! Truly disappointed! All I'm doing is renovating the characters parents entire house, by playing sooo many levels of what seems to be another copy of candy crush! Its ridiculous, for every tiny detail you have to play I.e. opening a package you have to play a level!! Complete waste of time!!!!! I didn't even wna giv 1 ⭐

Do not let your kids play this game. If you do, disable in-game purchases. The game has levels that are impossible to pass without purchases and will bombard the player with suggestions for purchases. In the end I got bored at not being able to progress after they give a super hard level and only 10 moves to complete it and then being asked "are you sure? You're going to lose all your progress". Don't bother.

I'm addicted but not enjoying it. It is pretty common to get stuck on levels which if you're determined like me you will spend money excessively for very little in return!! Many levels need boosters/power ups but they cost sooo much. I had no idea it was similar to candy crush. I downloaded it as the game was advertised very differently. I thought it was some kind of health & safety multiple choice. I will probably end up frustrated & deleting it. Download if you're a big spender. lol

Got boring quite quickly, it's just another candy crush clone with the 'reward' being that it advances the story and let's you pick a few furniture items. The home scaping is very loose, there's little interaction here. They've also included the mini games you see in the adverts probably to avoid any false advertising but they're inconsequential and the art style is completely different to the rest of the game.

The game starts off actually achievable, and then very quickly you find that it takes either 20+ tries to complete a level, or there's just no way around it without purchasing coins or extras. You start earning less for completing levels, and every other level is a "super hard" level. It just becomes completely unplayable and becomes a source of frustration rather than just being an enjoyable game. All these apps are the same.

The game is fun ,but I can agree with other people that some of the levels are RIDICULOUSLY hard. And I'm only on level 20. Sometimes you don't get enough moves! Could you make the lives cheaper?Being able to ask for lives is a helpful feature but the only social media there is Facebook. You could add Whatsapp and Instagram and Twitter and things. Facebook isn't the only one. I hope I haven't complained to much but I'm really not happy.Im likely going to delete the app soon. Sorry,

Its a real shame the way the game has developed into a cash grab. I played this game for multiple years since it used to give 65 energy for a completed level. when it did it felt like i challenge which was challenging but doable. but now it feels like it's impossible, considering there is not enough time to complete the main story nevermind the bonuses. it feels like a waste of time considering how much money you have to put into the game to feel like you've 'won', even if that's just the story.

Dishonest: This game is nothing like the advertising... seriously, what is the developer doing creating such false advertising. The game itself is quite good when you get into it... Personally however, if the gameplay was actually like the adverts, I think I would enjoy it more. As a message to the developer - please advertise real gameplay as opposed to false expectations. It's just not enjoyable to be let down like that. Still, great, fun game. Just left disappointed of what could have been.

When you've spent yet more hard earned stars, which you've painstakingly earned completing almost impossible levels (once you've progressed as far as the kitchen), on mundane tasks like making a call, opening a box, answering a door and chasing some bird across the room, you'll realize that the developers are not in for the long steady game. This is yet again a flash in the pan, aimed at grabbing money as quick as it can. Stick to the steady classics, avoid this rubbish like the plague

I've been playing this a long time.. it's just getting frustrating now. Yesterday I spent money to get through the level, it then froze and went off.. when it came back on, I had to start the level again, but had still taken the coins from before it froze. Some levels are so hard, so then to freeze when you pay to help get you through is a joke! Not happy 😒

Beyond pissed off!! Won 2nd place in a team tourney with my team of 3 players. Instead of having the prize of 90000 plot three-way, as any normal algorithm would do, we only got 3000 (which I didn't find out about until I looked in the FAQs, because you don't get told that in the game)! I was stupid to spend actual money on this game. Also gameplay sux, you make a special combo, the bricks go, but you don't get the combo. I should have taken this as a sign and stopped playing. Worst spent£25-30

It was fun to play, good animation and interactive but you need to spend a lot of money on coins. 900 coins for 5 moves! And then it increases. You can't pass these levels without getting more moves so you need to buy coins. There are hard and super hard levels but these seem easier? Weird. Any help you buy seems to go really quickly. At one point it completely reset and I lost the gold power powerball even though I wasn't losing! I have surpassed 1000 levels lol but I can't keep playing

Well, this incarnation of the game was ok when I started again from the beginning recently, but it's now been stuck all afternoon saying that it's 0% updated. I'm fed up. That's it for today. If it's the same tomorrow I'm uninstalling it. Again. At the end of the day there are so many of these candycrush clones that it won't be missed. I'm certainly not going to be conned into making any of the massively overpriced in-game purchases. £0.99 maybe, £8.99 in your dreams!

I liked this game initially but had to uninstall as it is impossible to progress through the levels without spending money! The further you go through the game the more stars you need to complete tasks and the 5 life limit is ridiculous! But no doubt another opportunity for game developers to make money as it costs to refill- or wait 20 minutes per 'life'. Also the butler is so annoying, that weird winky thing he does at the start of each level? Creepy

This game starts off okay as the levels are easy to rope you in. Then the levels get harder and the games more difficult to complete. I've been stuck on a level for ages and it is now boring and the fun has now gone. 900 coins for 5 moves is too much and I don't do them but leave until they refill. The website link gives one idea to look at the board and don't do random. Bit difficult when the board is insisting on a move and won't lay off until played. The creators need a smack. UNINSTALLED.

I really like this game and I think it has great potential but i don't like how as you advance in the game they make candy crush like part harder. Also with less moves and the fact that it takes hours to rank up lives and you have to give on of yours up to start a new day if it improved in these areas then It would be able to get 5 stars.

The game overall is really good but as you get further on it is difficult to actually even build up any money or bonuses you found yourself having to use them all for one game it'd be better if the games weren't so ridiculously hard. And when a task needs to be done now it takes three stars instead of the one so getting quite bored of having to redo same level just to get anyway. I'm updating my review as I've noticed quite a few glitches in this game which I'm really annoying. Quite a few the times when you go to make the the expected formation on the board it doesn't give you the thing that you are expected to get and sometimes it makes you redo levels as well

Really like this game, very addictive but would be better if you got 2 stars for the hard levels and 3 stars for the super hard levels as it can take ages for you to get stars to complete the quest. Also when you play the extra game with the cat, once you completed some of the levels but ran out of lives you shouldn't have to do them all over again, it would be better to start where you left off. That's why I gave 4 stars and not 5.

This game is awful. It's almost impossible to get power ups to go together so you can actually complete the levels. I'm only on level 67, just starting the second room. Unless you buy more coins then you're stuck. If you find spending money to complete the game fun, go for it.Total rip off, don't get it. Would give zero stars if I could.

the adverts for this game are so misleading. exactly the same as gardenscapes and the "challenges" you see in the advertisement are nothing like the game. just a simple match 'em game with a rubbish back story to make it seem different. not worth downloading or playing for any amount of time. definitely need to sort out the advert as well. bordering on false advertisement

enjoyed the game at first but it is now very very slow. false advertisements too as it is not a fix or repair game by choosing the right tools. power boosts are a waste of time as they are put in the wrong places at the start of the game when there are limited moves anyway and they cost a lot of money. it is off putting too to see all the other rooms that you may get chance to decorate but at the moment I see it very unlikely anyone ever gets out of the first room. has the potential to be good.

The game is OK. But the customer help awful. I've been playing since 2017, but not to worry they are unwilling to update the game for me, after losing everything transferring data on my new android, after looking for entirely 20 seconds. Forgetting that I spent $$$$ over the years. I was on level 4971 in HOMESCAPES and level 4861 in GARDENSCAPES. When i started playing these games if you wanted to change a design element you had to use your earned points or coins. I'm Done. Bye-bye

This game is getting to be very mundane & repetitive. I refused to use real money to progress and will stop playing it if it constantly failed my efforts. I noticed after a few days of non playing, the game became easier to progress when one returns to it. When I first started, it was entertaining, now it is getting stale & yes, money grabbing which I refused to indulge in. Plenty more games out there to play for free.

This game was quite addictive. I enjoyed playing. However, some levels, you are set up to fail unless you purchase lives and boosters, I mean actually impossible. Most of the time it's switched off waiting for my 5 lives to replenish so I can play the same ridiculous level again and again. I appreciate that's how developers of these games make a living, but I'd take an ad over having to pay out. Why do you think I'm playing this instead of being out!?

NOT AS ADVERTISED!!! I have enjoyed playing this game for a couple of years now but am very concerned by the adverts I now see for it (when playing other games) and shocked to see the pictures on the app store have been changed to reflect the misleading adverts. This game is nothing like the adverts and pictures show it. I do still enjoy the game but anyone considering downloading should know they are not getting what they are being led to believe. Terrible business practice!!

This game was really fun in the beginning, but I'm level 2069 and it is becoming less fun. The higher levels get many more super hard levels with very little moves to solve the puzzle. It becomes more frustrating then fun. I don't mind a challenge but hate being stuck on the same level for days. You have to use up all your helps and buy extra moves IF you have the coins, or spend money to buy more helps and still not guaranteed that they will get you thru that level.

I waited to play the game for a full two days before deciding I've seen enough to actually write an honest review. The game is basically a home makeover bejeweled. The game starts like any other, giving you ton of resources and generally being very easy to play and advance. Then when you're just out of the tutorial it shifts to being ridiculously hard and very money grabby. It also encourages you to share your social media and invite friends. Uninstalled. It's not that great tbh.

Yet another Playrix piece of junk. Nothing like it is advertised. Puzzles are made stupidly hard, to try and force you to pay real money for power ups, that are generally pretty useless. You just keep having to do the same puzzle for hours, or even days, until you get a set of tiles that actually makes it beatable. Uninstalled. Last time I try a Playrix game. Third one I have tried that has been like this.

The game itself isn't so bad, even if it's kind of babyish by nature. What's INFURIATING is how purposely difficult it is. They make doing the most simple tasks EXTREMELY difficult, because they want you to buy coins, so you can actually progress, and this is from the get go! There's literally no difficulty curve! If you don't enjoy games that stress you out, AVOID this game!

Game is impossible to play or win without constantly pumping money into it, I downloaded it because of a Facebook add and it has nothing to do with that, this is just a simple matching game, nothing else and even for that is a bad one, the right pieces never come together in the right time and place, so the game constantly asking for 900 gold for 5 more steps and even than its not enough, just keep paying and paying and paying, this is just a rip off, do not download it

Why do most games make it so hard to contact support when there's a problem with the game. I mean it's like chasing down a needle In a haystack. I'm stuck on level 98, no power ups. And only 15 moves to complete the level, come on seriously theres boxes and cookies, it's not possible to pass. Ya'll need to rethink your amount of moves that are offered and the game loses my interest if I can't pass the game after a half a dozen attempts. I'm not gonna try for days on 1 lvl

It was an amazing game but Financial model became horrendous. Levels are now so random that you, most of the time, can't finish even the 'easy ones' without either a stroke of huge luck, using boosters (which strangely seems to increase the chances of combos), using in game items or paying for additional moves (btw button made to press it by error) Events are just there to make you use your gold by error on the dynamites. Intrusive 'promo' pop ups. no clear definition of worth of IAP. etc

One flaw is that sometimes you can be stuck on a level for days or more, so you either need a lot of patience or you will need to spend real money to progress, and coins are not cheap to buy. Also, do not believe the advertising campaigns, they don't reflect the actual gameplay. The ads where you seem to have to choose the right tools to do a job? Never happens. It's false advertising!

Fantastic addictive game I just wish the cat bonus levels were a bit easier, it's impossible to reach the end. also some of the levels are very hard and take ages to complete, then as soon as you do complete it the next level is specified as hard or super hard. there is no difference between normal and hard levels. Just my opinion though

Honestly I love the game, but I hate how this game is all about having power-ups if you don't have them available on hard levels good luck passing them. This game is made for you to spend money and as a student that is independent its not something I wish to spend my money on. This game would be so much better if the levels were easier. Take for instance level 130. Why do you only get 11 moves.. I had to wait 2 days to get disco ball to pass this level. Otherwise it would be impossible.

I really like this game despite it not being what is advertised. I like the story and really enjoy redecorating the rooms. But I'm losing patience rapidly, I've done level 75 30 times now and that is not an exaggeration. I can't afford to buy coins and boosters but if you want to progress it seems you have to pay £££. Also, when I do progress I think it's harsh using stars for pointless tasks, I just want to redecorate so let me!

Game suppose to be fun, not torture! Homescapes is an example of unlimited amount of player teasing! to just see the game's damn story, this is opposite of fun, Creators need to find sane ways to convince players spend money, not by making normal/hard/super hard levels hell for us. You either can use gold and power-ups to getting out of misery or suffer from unreasonable level of difficulty, If I want drama for life there is numerous free ways to obtain it! so I'm leaving this game for good.

Absolutely love this game, been playing it a few years now. I'm on level 1994. Always events to do, race against other people etc. Only thing that is bugging me is how frequent the hard levels are. I have literally just got off of a level that I was stuck on, played about 4 levels (I could be wrong, I didn't count. It wasn't many though) and I am again on a hard level. I have noticed Purple levels are way harder than the Red ones.

Well, I like the renovation part of the game. Graphics are nice and I like watching at old stuff disappear and new appear. However, to get 1 star I need to complete level. Levels are made of basic candy crush, even power-ups are exactly the same as in candy crush, logic is same and level idea is same. That's just too boring. Also as further I go as more stars I need for a single thing to be upgraded. That's awful. Takes ages to complete boring long and sometimes way too hard levels to get 1 or 2 stars... You should change the system and make the game more enjoyable as I am already feeling like stopping playing it just because of candy crush part. I guess it's impossible to make levels easier now, too much of a developing work, however you could at least add 2 more stars for rewards so I can enioy game instead of getting mad at failed levels amd get bored of game. Hope you'll read this review instead of being ignorants.

Unless you want to pay to play, don't bother. The game is set up that you need to spend your money, to do up a virtual mansion. The entitled Son of the owners wanders around picking out rooms and furniture that need replacing. If you do not win the game at each level, he nods disappointedly because you haven't spent your cash, to try again.

It's a great game but after a while it gradually (purposely) gets harder and takes you longer to complete the puzzles , which is purposely done in order to get you to pay to get through the level. I've spent the last week on trying to complete one puzzle and I now give up. I'm not paying just so I can complete it. Sorry, but this is just rubbish. It's a shame. I enjoy it but I'm not paying.

A decent match 3 puzzle game, with almost entirely false advertising. As with all these games, the ring pull puzzle is barely ever there. I reached level 500+ and was offered exactly 6 ring pull puzzles. I've stopped playing now, I get a "hard" puzzle every 5-10 levels, some of which now are taking me multiple *days* to complete. They *are* possible without paying, I haven't paid a penny, but they're so purposefully hard and luck/rng reliant there is absolutely no fun left in it.

It's good to a point but some of the levels feel impossible without powerups and honestly it sucks all the fun out of it. stars are needed for stupid things and it feels like once you pass the easy levels progress is impossible without putting a tonne of money into it. If you watched an ad for more lives or for a power up it may be better because it just makes players want to stop when they can't get any further. more about playability, less about rinsing players for money.

Ok. The ads we are bombarded with show one game, a new type of game that looks fun. Not what you get when you download this game. It's the same as 100 other games out there (and it's not even a good version) so I will ba avoiding all games from this publisher hence forth. False advertising is a crime. We should be more strict with this. They show a better game than they provide just to get downloads.

Having played Gardenscapes for some time now and completed over 2200 levels I was looking forward to playing Homescapes. I've reached level 100 and I'm really ticked off at the continual hard and superhard levels. I don't mind paying out a bit of real cash on a game from time to time but I've uninstalled HS as I don't like being continually set up to fail just so I'll spend money.

The game is good, but it's a chore to earn stars and takes work that defeats the purpose, it end up being frustrating instead of enjoyable. Wouldn't recommend until the levels are less hard(as you level up it becomes impossible to beat a level cause theres only a limited spaces you can remove pieces). It's a nice game to start off with but isn't worth it cause you end up wasting time on 1 star earned per level and some of the items are like 3 or 2 stars which ends up being a waste of time.

Most boring game, if you want to get frustrated come and play this game. At first I thought as this is the new game maybe be I'm taking to much time to complete levels but no the levels are too hard and the moves are too less too. I had already uninstalled once and installed it again this time. I had installed garden scapes too, same goes with it...

I do like the game but I'm giving it 2 stars because of the misleading and false advertising I keep seeing from this company. It is disgusting and that's why y'all don't deserve more than 2. At the same time, you get a few easy levels and then on the hard and very hard levels it gets frustrating. I can get stuck on a level for days, ran out of all my boosters and coins and will just win it 4 days later just from pure luck. I can tell the algorithm of this game is kind of sketchy.

Tedious more often than fun. When it's fun, it's super fun, but I spend more time bored and annoyed by ridiculously difficult levels than I do having fun. It's addictive, yes. That doesn't mean it's a worthwhile use of my time. It's a good revenue stream, I'm sure, but for what it would cost to make this game reliably fun, I can pay for an online gaming membership and eat out several times a week. Not worth it.

currently on lvl 2240(hard level). way too many hard levels, makes the game less fun, boring and frustrating being stuck on the same level for so long. stars are being used for such dumb things, when theyre supposed to be towards renovating the home. what's the point in playing 3-4 levels just to get one task done. 900 coins for only 5 moves is dumb when you guys only give 50-100 coins a lvl, more if there's powerups left. please consider taking back our feedback and changing these things.

Great little game but...it takes way too long to get anywhere without spending a good bit. I've bought a few packages but never more than $2 per month. I want to play it every night but quickly run out of boosters and coins. I then have to wait until I've gotten enough boosters to play decently (which takes a week of checking in every night). Still, I like this game and like how the characters speak to you and each other - gives it a bit more story to follow. It's actually quite relaxing!

this game is so frustrating! most of the tasks require 2 stars, but the levels/games you have to complete usually only give you 1 star and most of them are incredibly hard! I spend a few days on a game/level, finally win and only get 1 star but I need 2 so I immediately have to do the next game, a few days later I finally have 2 stars. takes too long to get anything done. going to uninstall, which is a shame as it's a fab game!

FALSE ADVERTISING! I downloaded the game because the ad made it look like you had to choose different items and fix different things. I've made it all the way to level 303 and the situations played out in the ad have not happened. It's just a knock off of candy crush. Don't advertise a game to be something completely different from what it is.

Been playing for over 20 years. If you want to stop having fun & just be angry and frustrated with how hard the higher levels are, and only want to get through them to finish decorating, then this is the game for you. Unless, unlike me, you've got MONEY. Then you can just buy your way through. And those extra pull pin side games they show in their ads? I've never seen one.

I played Homescapes for a few years, I really enjoyed it, but after reaching higher levels I would get stuck for weeks sometimes, the game offers level help from your group members on occasion but without spending real money and way too few moves given you can beat levels, the developers say you absolutely can beat them without using real money, it's just not true, so the game has run it's course for me, I've moved on to another game that has a fun story and level help always from your game crew

I downloaded this app based on adds from a different app, and it was nothing as it was portrayed to be. Very disappointing that the levels are incredibly difficult unless you spend actual money to buy power boosts to aid in level completion. I am extremely disappointed. The only positive part is that the app was free so I didn't waste any money!

Not like the ads If you're going to make ads to hype up your game and get people interested, why can't u just make the game that way. I played one mini game which was a low quality version of the ads. If it was like that the whole way through I would have been annoyed at quality but still played, instead it's deceiving. It is bejewelled but with stars to design the house.

When there is a time sensitive side project, harder levels are what you get so you have to pay to advance. Basically a match 3 game. It was easily a 5 star game to start and a lot of fun. You earn stars in the game by beating levels then you use them to make improvements to the house. However, the levels kept getting harder and now it takes days to beat one level. I hate the super hard levels. Not much fun anymore.

Uninstalled, managed to get to over level 8000 but now I've had enough, don't get enough coins or power ups, gotta pay real cash to get them, to many super hard levels to close together, this game just causes me stress and no enjoyment at all, I've just had a super hard level that took me over a week to complete, then an easy level that was quite hard, then a hard level that took a day to complete, then I get another super hard level, I had like less than 400 coins and 0 power ups, uninstalled

Honestly, this game is a very good game, I love the technique, the style, the music, the minigames you have to complete, everything about it is good. There are a few minor mistakes I would like to point out for the people wanting to download this game, but dont know the potential. First off, some of the minigames are extremely hard. I like how you caneanr rewards to help with the minigames, but still. Some are very hard. That's the only thing I would change. Overall this game is fab and addictin

I should of read the reviews. Sadly they are right. Misleading game. Dont expect it to be anything like the advertisement you see for it. Its a candy crush game twist in order to progress in the game. I teied it for a little and it got so complicated at the beginning that i was so frustrated and uninstalled the game. Would not recommend this game!!!

Hi, for the last 5 days I've not been getting my log in/ check in bonus. It is stuck on day 1 and says "come back tomorrow for more rewards".. I play every day and its still on day 1. I have cleared my, then I tried clearing my data and I have even tried to uninstall the game and reinstalled it but it is still the same. Please help as I'm looking out on my rewards! Tried help and support but only automatic responses.

It gets bogged down on small tasks where you need 2-4 star's and you don't feel like your progressing far in the game which becomes infuriating!!!. The game encourages you to spend money so that you can progress though the levels. I do like that it gives you awards but its only if your successful in completing your tasks, on the down side you can get stuck of a while on levels.

No skill required. Game will let you win when it feels like it. Uninstalled because even the easy levels were getting too difficult to complete without spending money on boosts. Like a fruit machine, it knows when to let you succeed so you don't have to really think to play this. An undo button would have been useful as mistakes get made with fat fingers and I'd liked to have co.pleted the house just to see but it was just too slow progress.

I was really enjoying this game but it has now got almost impossible to pass levels without boosters and unfortunately to get boosters you have to spend your own money!! Occasionally you do get boosters as a reward but not enough. The game money you earn goes into a pot that you have the option of BUYING!! Like every other 'free's game, you can't enjoy it unless you spend your actual cash which I personally find unfair. I have now uninstalled the game after spending days trying to pass a level!!

I love this game, I have been playing for 6 months now, the puzzles are great, if you stick at the hard levels you'll eventually beat them within 40 lives, and you gain enough free boosters to never have to pay any real money to get far in this game, unlike other similar games. Edit: I've been playing this game for nearly 2 years now, and I haven't spent a penny on it, I'm level 3000 and something, things have really slowed down, generally I get stuck for a few days, but I still love this game

Great game concept wise and I'm somewhat addicted at the moment. But am considering deleting it as not getting very far, very fast. Trying to get stars so I can actually decorate is driving me nuts as some of the puzzles are hard and take ages to complete making it become repetative. Takes ages to get one star and it's used straight away and not always on decorating but other silly tasks. I want to play the decorating and not have to pay in app. Maybe harder levels should give more stars.

Enjoyable but some of the levels are nigh on impossible with the few moves provided. The storyline is engaging and the graphics are great but too many stars are needed for the most simple task. Laying a path - 6 stars, really? Placing some flowers - 4 stars, really? There's no consistency in the 'cost' to do tasks...1 star should be sufficient to do each task, two at most - especially as they are so hard won. I have spent money on the game as I like the story, when I have time to kill.

perfect for a bit of time wasting and building and replacing items in the house extremely enjoyable, however the gameplay itself can be frantically frustrating and annoying I would not recommend this game for anyone that is easily annoyed. note for developer the game can be better if the progress can be rolled on the next game e.g. if you are collecting two different items and you collect one sets before you run out of moves then you should not have worry about them in the next try.

New review: I have realised the following: 1. I played more than 4200 levels, the levels are now almost impossible and no longer fun to play. 2. I buy coins when I like a level, but suspect the programming is not random. If you buy once, it feels like you cannot beat levels without byuing again. 3. Weekends seem to have the algorithms set tougher than the week. For two weeks I have made no payments and have sat for 4-5 days with one level until Monday. Then winning is easy. I give up, I go!

This game ranges from the ridiculous to outright face bitingly impossible... some of the levels are so easy you finish with half your moves left. While some of the 'hard' levels are designed in such a way your starting boosters become irrelevant, and you only pass the level when the game almost does it for you. I have spent weeks on some of the harder levels. i have now decided to walk away. it was fun for a while, but not now that it feels like a chore...

You've played this game a thousand times before. The gameplay is another Candy Crush clone. Gimmick is you earn stars which in turn do stuff to your house. The difficulty curve is all over the place, regardless of level. I am at level 800 and even now I can fly through 10-20 levels within half an hour then be stuck on a 'normal' level for a week. Luck plays a HUGE if not CORE part rather than skill, unfortunately, which pushes played to buy the in-app items which at its basis: is a scam.

Enjoyed it in the early stages, then you get to level 30 where you have 22 moves to collect 80 tiles of a nominated colour (which you get by swapping adjacent tiles to make a matching row of 3). Its next to impossible to complete. I'm sure it suddenly becomes possible though if you buy into the "aw no, did you fail? No problem! buy more lives!!" like it asks. Really annoyed me!!!

Too difficult. The levels have got ridiculously hard. You only get one star reward and have to spend it on stupid tasks. Look at the cat, stroke the cat, feed the cat etc. It is a house decorating game. At times the bombs don't create as much damage obviously on purpose so you lose and have to spend money to proceed. If you need one red block to win after 6 moves no red blocks come.100% CHEATS FOR SURE. It has quite nice graphics but otherwise has become too stressful for me. I will DELETE.

The game is good, the match 3 and home decorating elements are good but they make it too hard. There are levels that you need to buy things to get past or you just stay stuck on them, and they make the decorating elements cost more so to do something basic can be multiple stars. They also add in a ton of non decorating tasks that you can't ignore or other tasks won't generate. I wound up deleting after spending all my 'money' and power ups and still failing a level because I didn't buy.

I downloaded this after watching an ad for it and it was nothing like the ad. Very frustrating. Levels were also very difficult had to delete it after I couldn't do one of the levels. Played the same levels for 6 weeks without luck and used all the boosters, I would go and play pretty much as soon as lives regenerated. Also wish I could do both homescapes and gardenscapes in the same game. It would also be nice to have customisable features even if you had to pay with in game coins.

I really like this game, just a little complain... When we received, said 30min unlimited hearts, could you create a way where we can choose when to use it!? Even if you give them with a expired time, most of the time I just want to try a difficult stage and when I win it I don't have time to keep playing. Not to mention the 3 hours... I really envy the person who can play the same game for 3 hours... Still it's a fun game. Thanks

I like the game (although the storyline is a bit twee). However, pieces on the gameboard keep flashing/moving to indicate where to make a booster, or 3 in a row. It's distracting, and makes it difficult to create the booster you actually need. Sometimes it doesn't respond to your touch unless you do what it's suggesting. *Edit - I'm on level 1525 which is, not just difficult but, impossible to beat without an extraordinary amount of luck. So uninstalling. Been fun up until now.

First: It is nothing like the ads show, false marketing! It is initially a great game, but around level 24-28 it becomes a "pay to win" money pit game. It feels absolutely impossible to complete the levels without boosters or additional lives - that, realistically, you can only buy for real money. When you keep trying to solve the very same level 10, 20, 30 times without even being close to the goal your frustration grows and just stop playing it altogether...

this is an excellent match 3 game with interesting powerups, fun gameplay, and bright colours. so why am i rating this so poorly? predatory microtransactions. the game seems to cheat after a certain point. sure, you can fairly easily get to level 300 or so, but at that point you will often find you can't progress any further without using boosters on EVERY stage, even the "normal" ones. you just don't have enough moves or moves get wasted, unless you pay money. then it's mysteriously easy again!

I started out enjoying this game. I completely understand a level being "hard", but when you spend days/weeks just trying to get through it, then I'm ready to move on to game that doesn't make it virtually impossible to get through, and I refuse to spend money in order to do that. And I agree, they have designed this game to make sure the paper planes never hit a target worth hitting...Ugh!!!

A shame really. The game is actually pretty decent, like a better version of candy crush. However, the good parts are unfortunately tainted by: 1. false advertising of some multiple choice puzzle game (don't even understand why, since the actual game is nice) 2. Not skill based, rigged levels. The supposed "difficulties" are nonsense and completely arbitrary. Many combo matches often gets ignored by the game, based on presumably some algorithm that only let's you win if you lose 50 times.

This game starts off at a high difficulty and fails to keep the player's interest. Rewards for passing a level are too low, tasks require too many points. Not to mention this game's marketing campaign is too aggressive and the false advertising is irritating. I played this game last year and uninstalled it already, I'm tired of seeing dozens of ads for this game in every single app I use, especially when the ads don't even match the actual gameplay.

When you get to a certain level the paper plans if you need them never help you, infact they do the opposite and you will loose so that can be very frustrating and you cant get off that level. So for that reason i cant give 5 stars. Some levels are very good but when you get a bad one then it can take over a week to try get through it and that can make you want to uninstall it x

I liked the game, but some of the levels are too hard and to tell you of an example I've been trying to pass a super hard level for over 3 months now!! I know it's a super hard level but that a little too hard!! just wish was how was in the beginning with no hard or super hard level its ridiculous. I'm just going to uninstall as found other games that are easier and more enjoyable to play then this. took the fun out of it now.

I like the game a lot, but sometimes it is way to hard on some levels and I am stuck on a level and have to play it 50 times to pass it or pay money for coins I could go through in less than an hour its not worth my time and certainly not my money! We should get more coins and be credited coins for playing, even if we are not able to complete the level, also get two stars on the hard levels. My phone heats up really bad and starts acting crazy if I play very long. Please help us to enjoy the game more!! Thanks

I've played for a week now. i have complaints. i downloaded it cuz of an ad i saw on another game. I'm on level 86 & still haven't encountered the puzzle in the ad. every puzzle is essentially candy crush but harder. they are stingy with power ups/coins. you have to be patient to save up coins. the power ups are crazy over priced, (900-3000 coins, but they only give you 50-100 a game). plus i think the counters for collecting things in the puzzles are wrong. storyline is slow; frustrating.

Game far too much pay to win. 900 coins to get 5 extra moves to beat a level but at most you only get about 60 coins after completing a level. levels get very difficult very quickly so you almost have to have boosters to win the game. I think the game would be better served by having the coins used for special decorating items that you could buy so you can have a unique looking house and having unlimited moves in the matching game.

I enjoyed playing this game but after making a few purchases last year (only special offers that randomly flash up) I have been charged in excess of 20 times since!! Daily this week, sometimes twice a day! Even though I have not requested to purchase anything and definitely have not received the 'handful of coins' I keep being invoiced and charged for! Frustrating.

Ok updating this review. The levels are clearly designed to be just hard enough to encourage microtransactions. The game reminds you constantly in a predatory way, during events, that you'll lose points and have your medals downgraded if you fail the level, unless you cash in. The levels are entertaining and fun when they don't try to monetize the difficulty spikes. Making your mansion prettier is the nice thing about the game. Conclusion: avoid spending on microtransactions!

I wrote review a few times, but it seems to dissappear every time. Dunno, if it's because developers can't handle criticism, but it happened to many time for coincidence. Anyway, I played for long time up to level 1400ish. Beginning is nice, but then game is getting more and more annoying. Sometimes it took days to pass one level and recently they added alarm clocks, in my opinion it crossed the line. I would say avoid it. Who needs extra frustration in life?

Money grabbing app. I have spent quite alot of money on the app, as £0.99 isn't alot to beat a level, however every level you need to get the extra lives. I know they say every level is designed to be beaten without boosters, but they don't say the odds it takes to get the right combos....could take upto 100 tries just to beat one level. I have done the wise thing to uninstall this game and not pump any more money into it. It's a fun game but beware it becomes addictive and you need to pump $in

I have recently noticed that in the past few months the amount of moves given to complete a game are almost half what they used to be. I'm currently stuck on a level that has 14 moves, a month ago it had 26!!! Seriously contemplating uninstalling as the enjoyment has been taken away and frustration has taken over! I know I'm not the only one who has noticed the changes! I used to purchase the gold ticket & occasionally the gold coins but I REFUSE to spend anymore!!! Please sort it out!!!

Fun game. I enjoy doing up the rooms. I wish there were more of the mini games. There are a few downfalls I find with this game such as some of the matching games to get the stars in order to get the tasks done are too hard as there are not enough moves. I also don't like the waste of time bits in between, the chatter between the characters and the pointless tasks which makes it take forever to get one room done, you shouldn't have to complete a game just to greet a guest or make a phone call.

best game, has NO ADS. though I won't mind a optional ad in return for a few extra moves (even just 2) has I am on 1 thousand & 7 hundred & something, so I have some very difficult levels, so any coins I earn soon go & can't afford to keep buying coins and number of times I only needed another 1/2 moves to finish it, but don't have the coins to buy the extra moves, so gaining a extra 2/3 in exchange for watching ad would be welcome, has don't mind ads if optional & I get a reward.

It's nothing like the ads. I was under the impression that it's a game where you have to fix rooms by choosing objects. Instead it's another version of Candy Crush, and it gets difficult pretty quickly, with levels becoming almost impossible to complete without spending real money. I like the whole designing element , but it's difficult to progress as stars are needed to complete actions, but you can only get them through completing the levels. Would not recommend.

I've played this game for a while now, on and off. It's more about gardening as the previous one than doing the house up. It's also really obvious about letting you get a couple of moves away from completing a level before busting out to encourage you to spend ££. I can spend ages on one level until the game suddenly decides I can move forward or I've amassed 900 coins for a few extra moves. Shame as it started out fun.

The game is NOT as advertised. It is a candy crush style game, you get stars for completing levels which are then used to get tasks done but they are done for you, you don't get to "fix" anything! Also once you've levelled up a few times,the levels become impossible to complete because there are far too few moves for what you need to collect. I know it's no fun if it's too easy but at least make the levels possible! I refuse to buy coins and boosters, games should be playable without real money!

this game is really good, but there could be improvements. for example, giving the player a keyboard so they can talk back to Austin, or giving the player an avitar to control and move. another main one is to give the player more freedom and advantages, otherwise, it becomes boring and stressful. there are a few others, but i won't go into detail too much. apart from that, this game is fun and addictive. ENJOY!!!!!!!!!!!

Not as advertised. The ads for fixing problems like putting out a fire looked interesting. I downloaded because I want a new style of puzzle game to play. This is nothing like that. It's a Candy Crush type matching game and the levels get really difficult, really fast. The graphics are great but the progress is interminably slow without spending significant real cash. Misleading con. Unimpressed. Will be uninstalling.

this game is like Candy crush, only much better. yes, you have to clear puzzles with power ups and extra moves etc. but you get rewarded with stars after every successful puzzle board. these can then be used to upgrade your home. you can choose between different upgrades to upgrade to your taste, but can also change your mind at any time. yes, you can spend money but you don't really need to. a classic timewaster, but with enough interest to keep you playing. well done.

Started off as a great game. Its great having the levels give stars to complete tasks. However its got to a point now where they have followed the style of candy crush where the levels get increasingly impossible and you have to buy things to progress. Really disappointing, especially when the whole point of the game is to do renovations which you can't do without winning levels.

Could be absolutely fantastic. I love decorating and furnishing the house etc, but the levels can be frustratingly difficult (obviously to coerce you into using power ups), and then you're forced to spend so many stars on mundane activities like "feed the parrot" to advance - which is annoying when you've taken so long just to get past the level in the first place.

Originally gave this 5 stars, then I got to a level which was impossible to complete in the number of turns given. Basically it's a set-up to make you pay for more turns. That, coupled with misleading advertising, made me delete the app altogether. The thing is, I would have happily made a one off payment to buy this as overall it's a good concept and graphics/gameplay/ etc are good, but the makers trying to mislead customers and underhandedly get more and more money out of us has put me off.

A very boring game. Having to complete 2 difficult levels just to take a TV out of its box. Really? Absolutely nothing resembling the game in the ads it saturates other games with. Totally misleading. And to top it off, a main character who starts calling me his best friend after a few levels. A bit weird for me, thanks. Uninstalling after precisely one day.

Homescapes as a game is fantastic! It's levels and stories are enjoyable but it lacks a little bit of the freedom aspect to do what you want, which although it's addictable, can make it a little tiresome! Also, the pictures are a little deceptive as the levels you have to complete are not the main focus. However, overall, the game is enjoyable and I enjoy listening to the story and *cleaning up*.

This game is good and the side mini game has potential but the levels are quite hard after a certain point as you have to rely on a lot of luck if you have ran out of boosters. I think there should be easy medium hard choice maybe, and those on harder levels get more stars per completed level. I'm uninstalling this game as I have tried way too long to get past a level, which is a shame because I'm enjoying the other aspects of the game. Thank you for your hard work in this game. :-)

The idea of the game is nice, but the mini games are too difficult (even the first ones). You have a few easy ones to keep you hooked up and then many impossible ones where the only way to pass is to use boosters as there's clearly too few moves available for the task. Obviously the boosters are not easy to get and the reward after winning a game is just one star and a few coins (but they require 900 for 5 extra moves). Also I'm now wasting time to name and feed a cat when it should be about renovating a house! Maybe the cat can be a side quest, not a mandatory one to continue the game!

This game has it's moments but you very rarely play the levels shown in the adverts which is what I downloaded it for. To begin with you play about 3-4 of the games matching items levels, you'll get an escape level come up which are the most entertaining parts of this game. Eventually you don't see them anymore. I uninstalled it as it's morphed into a pay to win as I've gone on. Needless to say I haven't wasted any money on this and advise anyone not to. Only winner's here are the developers.

It's a match the symbols game where you earn stars so you can buy items to redecorate the house. It looks good but it really isn't as advertised (hence the low rating). If you like "match the shapes to make them disappear in various combinations to complete the level" type games then go for it as it's quite good. If you're after the game they advertise in the clickbait then don't bother.

At first, the game was enjoyable. Beating levels, decorating house, and enjoyed story. The longer you play, the duller the story gets and the levels become almost impossible to beat unless you purchase more coins to continue playing. I've been playing this for a few years and I'm really disappointed. And also, DON'T TRUST THE ADVERTISING VIDEOS! All fake; this game is not what is advertised. They tried to insert the gamemode of moving bars and getting past obstacles, but failed miserably.

It's a nice game but some levels are mis-graded, they're impossible to get through without boosters. You have to attempt again and again until the computer gives you a winning combination of where the tiles fall. It's a gem drop kind of thing. Some easy levels are hard, some hard ones can be easy. It doesn't get plagued with ads, but it's frustrating sometimes. It's there to make money from you, like a lot of games these days.

I really enjoy this game but the higher up the levels you get it becomes more obvious that the game developers have the code set up for you to fail. There are dozens of times I've matched 4,or a square of 4 etc and it's not registered a paper plane, or other special piece. I see new pieces falling down and matching to make a special piece but again, I'm not awarded the special piece. These levels don't necessarily get more difficult, they become more rigged against the player!

Starts great but then ruined. The concept is really cute and you gain stars to complete the tasks by solving the puzzles. The puzzles became increasingly hard which is fun, but not when they become impossible and the only option is to purchase boosters. Also in the adverts it shows more of the "dude is trapped help him out" scenarios but I think after 3 weeks of playing on off, I only did 3? Had to delete at level 80 as couldn't get through without having to purchase.

The game is fun, I enjoy playing it here and there. The reason I dont play it more is because there is just too much to do in each room to unlock the next. Hang photos, clock musket, armour, sort out stuff.... the list is endless. I dont really want 35 things to do before i get to explore the next bit. I'm on level 736 and I still have loads more areas to unlock. I appreciate making the game interesting, but considering the stars are getting harder to obtain, it's getting boring now.

Pretty standard CC-style Match-3 gameplay, which was NOT what was advertised by the ads. As fun as the story is, the gameplay itself is repetitive, and I've grown bored of replaying the same kinds of levels... especially as the higher-end levels spiked in unfair difficulty, made worse by random often unwinnable boards with too much clutter and too few moves to even come close to clearing the increasingly demanding objectives! Games are supposed to be FUN, not boring!

Used to like this a lot, but now deleted it. There is one level that cannot be completed without extending the number of moves and if you don't win no rewards...so cannot be completed unless you purchase a bonus pack. The in-game rewards are worthless, whereas the cash purchases packs huge...but if you can't complete a level...then it's either pay or delete. Very greedy developers indeed. Shameful for a kids game.

Enjoyable, challenging, fun, rewarding. Really like the game. It's great that you can earn coins and then spend those on things to help you along in the game. You don't really NEED to buy coins. As you progress in the game and get to higher levels, more competitions will become available and you can earn extra coins, boosters and lives. Been playing for ages, gonna keep playing for ages still! :D

Frustrating. There is a built in algorithm that will not let you go past a certain level on the first day (or so) of trying. I have had cases of playing the same level for 2 hours with unlimited life and not getting past it. Log in next day - finished with no power ups with 10+ moves left. The game is design to take your money. I would strongly advise against using it.

Good graphics. A bit stingy on the rewards. Not good having to pay 900 coins for 5 extra goes when you can buy a whole 5 lives for the same price. Having said that I do like this game, I think it's good fun. Austin is not as creepy as he is in Gardenscapes. A very annoying glitch after the latest update is that you cannot exit the game, the only way for me is to close all tabs. Not satisfactory at all.

I loved the game at first. But when I took more notice, I saw that during the game, you don't recieve all the planes, rainbow balls...etc that you should. Many times Ive made a satregic move, & got nothing. The game could be improved by adding a "Get out of jail free" option. Which you win after you achieve so many rainbow balls..etc.To allow you to end a level that your stuck on. It would stop the hot heads uninstalling the game, when they get stuck on a level & cant get past it.

I have played this game for years, on an almost daily basis. I have spent money on occasion, and have noticed them get more pushy but tolerated it. Today, their new 'homepass' forces the user to click through to it, claim a free 'prize' and then get to the payment page. This was an insane jump from pushy typical behavior, to walking someone forcibly through to purchase. Don't care if it's 5 years and many levels, uninstalled immediately.

A mildly fun time waster but I only downloaded the game thinking it was point and click based on the adverts. Unfortunately it's yet another matching game and, as per usual these days, it's obviously pay to progress. Some of the games are virtually impossible to complete unless you pay for extra moves or just play the level so often you get lucky. You guys need to stop these deceptive practices cos you're ruining your own industry and people will just stop downloading. It's getting boring now!

I've dropped my rating from a 5 to a 1 for the following reasons. • Coins won for levels used to be 50/100/150 for easy, hard and superhard levels. Now we are getting hardly any coins at all. 10 on my last level. • Levels now seem to be harder.
